event_templates.title: The Beggar's Warning
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A ragged beggar blocks your path, warning of danger ahead.

event_templates.title: The Abandoned Cart
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A merchant cart sits abandoned on the road. Signs of struggle nearby.

event_templates.title: The Crying Child
event_templates.visible_text_summary: You hear a child crying near the road. Could be a trap.

event_templates.title: The Crossroads Oracle
event_templates.visible_text_summary: An old figure at the crossroads offers fortunes for those who dare hear.

event_templates.title: The Overturned Noble's Carriage
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A noble's carriage lies overturned. The noble appears injured and desperate.

event_templates.title: The Ravenous Wolves
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A pack of wolves blocks the path, hunger in their eyes.

event_templates.title: The Merchant's Desperate Offer
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A desperate merchant offers premium payment for escort through dangerous territory.

event_templates.title: The Old Battlefield
event_templates.visible_text_summary: You pass an old battlefield. Bones and rusted weapons litter the ground.

event_templates.title: The Sudden Storm
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A violent storm hits. Visibility drops and the path becomes treacherous.

event_templates.title: The Deserting Soldier
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A frightened soldier flees in your direction, still in uniform.

event_templates.title: The Drunkard's Tale
event_templates.visible_text_summary: In a tavern, a drunk rambling about something important catches your attention.

choices.label: Buy him more drinks for details

event_templates.title: The Price-Fixing Scheme
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Traders complain that a guild monopoly has inflated prices beyond reason.

event_templates.title: The Sick Child
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A desperate mother begs for medicine for her dying child.

event_templates.title: The Festival Night
event_templates.visible_text_summary: The settlement holds a festival. Crowds gather, morale is high.

event_templates.title: The Hidden Cult Meeting
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Your companion spots hooded figures entering a warehouse at midnight.

event_templates.title: The Disputed Tax Collection
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Tax collectors demand payment but residents claim they're not legitimate.

event_templates.title: The Wanted Poster
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A fresh wanted poster offers a bounty for a notorious criminal.

event_templates.title: The Refugee Wave
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Refugees stream into the settlement, straining resources.

event_templates.title: The Masterblacksmith's Offer
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A master blacksmith offers to upgrade company weapons for a significant fee.

event_templates.title: The Plague Ship
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A ship arrives with sick passengers. Quarantine is being discussed.

event_templates.title: The Night Confession
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A companion wishes to speak privately by the fire.

event_templates.title: The Strange Sounds
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Unusual sounds come from the darkness beyond the firelight.

event_templates.title: The Rival Mercenary Company
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Another mercenary company makes camp nearby. Their leader approaches.

event_templates.title: The Injured Traveler
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A wounded traveler stumbles into your camp, begging for help.

event_templates.title: The Midnight Theft
event_templates.visible_text_summary: You wake to find supplies missing and unusual tracks around camp.

event_templates.title: The Ancient Shrine
event_templates.visible_text_summary: An old shrine stands nearby. Its stones glow faintly in moonlight.

event_templates.title: The Quarrel Between Companions
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Two companions argue heatedly over a past grievance.

event_templates.title: The Hunting Party Success
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Companions return successfully from hunting with fresh game.

event_templates.title: The Desertion Temptation
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A companion approaches with a worried expression about the company's future.

event_templates.title: The Wandering Bard
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A bard seeks shelter for the night, offering songs and news in exchange.

event_templates.title: The Guild War Begins
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Open conflict erupts between the Trader's Guild and Craftsmen's Guild.

event_templates.title: The Cult Infiltration
event_templates.visible_text_summary: A cult has infiltrated the settlement's leadership.

event_templates.title: The Noble Succession Crisis
event_templates.visible_text_summary: The noble house's leader is dead. Two claimants fight for succession.

event_templates.title: The Militia Mutiny
event_templates.visible_text_summary: The militia refuses orders and demands better pay and conditions.

event_templates.title: The Criminal Syndicate Takeover
event_templates.visible_text_summary: The criminal syndicate moves to take control of the settlement's underworld.

event_templates.title: The First Omen
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Strange omens appear in the sky. Animals behave oddly. Children speak of nightmares.

event_templates.title: The Grain Blight
event_templates.visible_text_summary: The grain harvest is blighted. Without imported food, famine is certain.

event_templates.title: The Desertion Wave
event_templates.visible_text_summary: Soldiers desert in groups, fleeing from a losing war. They pass through the region.

event_templates.title: The Refugee Flood
event_templates.visible_text_summary: War refugees arrive in massive numbers, overwhelming the settlement.

event_templates.title: The Water Source Poisoning
event_templates.visible_text_summary: The settlement's well water has been poisoned. Sickness spreads.
